아니요.forms: short: 아뇨 · casual: 아니 · formal: 아닙니다
아니요.e: From 아니다 (to not be); often shortened to 아뇨, and casually just 아니.
아니요.t: Don't mix it up with 아니에요 ('it isn't' / 'not at all'), the usual reply to 감사합니다.

손.e: Base of 손가락 (finger) and 손목 (wrist, 'hand neck').
손.t: Give and receive things with two hands when dealing with elders.

걸리다.m: to take (time); to catch (a cold); to hang (be hung)
걸리다.x: It takes thirty minutes from home to school.
걸리다.e: Passive of 걸다 (hang); 감기에 걸리다 = catch a cold.
걸리다.t: Ask duration: 얼마나 걸려요? 'How long does it take?'

늦게.forms: 늦게 + verb: 늦게 자요, 늦게 와요
늦게.x: I went to bed late last night.
늦게.e: 늦다 (to be late) + -게 (adverb ending). Opposite: 일찍 (early).

열심히.forms: 열심히 + verb: 열심히 공부해요, 열심히 일해요
열심히.x: I'm studying hard because of the exam.
열심히.e: Literally 'with a hot heart' — 열심 + 히 (-ly). 열심히 공부해요 = study hard.

졸리다.m: to be sleepy, to feel drowsy
졸리다.ex: 어젯밤에 늦게 자서 지금 너무 졸려요.
졸리다.x: I went to bed late last night, so I'm really sleepy now.
졸리다.e: From 졸다 (to doze): feeling like you'll nod off.

어르신.x: Sir, there's a seat here, so please sit down.
어르신.e: Related to 어른 'adult, elder'; the respectful term for older people.
어르신.t: A polite way to address an elderly stranger directly, like 'sir' or 'ma'am'.

닮다.m: to resemble, to look like, to take after
닮다.x: I look more like my mother than my father.
닮다.t: Use the past form 닮았어요 for 'looks like' now; pronounced [담따].

아메리카노.x: Even when it's cold, I drink iced americanos.
아메리카노.e: From Italian 'americano' — espresso diluted with water.
아메리카노.t: Iced americano is often shortened to 아아 (casual). The joke 얼죽아 (얼어 죽어도 아이스 아메리카노) means 'iced americano even if I freeze to death'.

멍멍.x: The neighbor's puppy barks 'woof woof' every night.
멍멍.e: 의성어 (sound word) imitating a dog's bark.
멍멍.t: 멍멍이 is baby talk for 'doggy'. The verb for barking is 짖다.

향상되다.ex: 매일 연습해서 한국어 실력이 많이 향상됐어요.
향상되다.x: I practiced every day, so my Korean improved a lot.
향상되다.e: Literally 'toward up' — moving upward, getting better.
향상되다.t: To improve something yourself, use 향상시키다: 실력을 향상시키다.

한라산.ex: 제주도에 가면 한라산에 꼭 올라가 보고 싶어요.
한라산.x: When I go to Jeju, I really want to climb Hallasan.
한라산.e: Traditionally read as 'mountain high enough to pull down the Milky Way'.
한라산.t: Pronounced [할라산]. At 1,947 m it is the highest mountain in South Korea.

선크림.x: Be sure to put on sunscreen before you go out.
선크림.e: Konglish from English 'sun' + 'cream'; English speakers say 'sunscreen'.
선크림.t: Put it on is 선크림을 바르다; the formal term is 자외선 차단제 'UV blocker'.

코로나.m: COVID-19, the coronavirus; the COVID pandemic
코로나.ex: 코로나 때문에 이 년 동안 고향에 못 갔어요.
코로나.x: Because of COVID, I couldn't go back to my hometown for two years.
코로나.e: From 'corona(virus)'. The official Korean name is 코로나바이러스감염증-19, shortened to 코로나19 [코로나 일구].
코로나.t: Koreans say 코로나 for both the disease and the pandemic period: 코로나 때 'during COVID', 코로나에 걸리다 'to catch COVID'.

범죄자.x: The police are chasing the criminal who ran away.

체온계.x: When I checked with a thermometer, my temperature was 38 degrees.
체온계.e: Literally 'body-warmth meter'. -계 = measuring device: 온도계, 시계.

판소리.ex: 판소리는 한 명의 소리꾼과 북 치는 사람이 함께 공연해요.
판소리.x: Pansori is performed by one singer together with a drummer.
판소리.e: 판 'open stage, scene' plus 소리 'sound, song'; a UNESCO-listed storytelling art.

실험실.x: The students are doing an experiment in the lab.
실험실.t: Often pronounced [시럼실] — ㅎ between sounds is nearly silent.

수리비.x: The laptop repair cost more than I expected.
수리비.e: -비 = cost or fee: 수리비, 교통비, 식비.
수리비.t: Costs 'come out' in Korean: 수리비가 10만 원 나왔어요.

어처구니없다.ex: 그런 어처구니없는 실수를 하다니 믿을 수가 없어요.
어처구니없다.x: I can't believe he made such an absurd mistake.
어처구니없다.e: Origin of 어처구니 is uncertain; the popular 'millstone handle' story is unproven.

골똘히.forms: 골똘히 생각하다 (almost always with thinking verbs)
골똘히.ex: 그는 창밖을 보며 골똘히 생각에 잠겼어요.
골똘히.x: He looked out the window, lost deep in thought.
골똘히.e: From 골똘하다 'to be absorbed in one thing'.

흔쾌히.forms: 흔쾌히 + verb: 흔쾌히 승낙하다, 흔쾌히 도와주다
흔쾌히.x: My friend gladly helped me move.

할인점.x: I bought household goods all at once at a discount store.
할인점.t: Pronounced [하린점]: the ㄹ carries over to the next syllable.

간편 결제.ex: 간편 결제를 등록해 두면 비밀번호만 누르면 돼요.
간편 결제.x: If you register for simple payment, you just enter your PIN.
간편 결제.e: 간편 'simple and convenient' + 결제 'payment' (literally 'decide and settle').
간편 결제.t: Your card or account is saved in an app, so you pay online or in shops with a PIN, fingerprint or face scan instead of typing card details. In everyday speech these services are called 페이.

횡령.ex: 그는 회사 돈을 횡령한 혐의를 받고 있어요.
횡령.x: He is suspected of embezzling company money.
횡령.e: Literally 'taking sideways', diverting what isn't yours.
횡령.t: Pronounced [횡녕] — ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

팽창.x: When water freezes, its volume expands by about 10%.
팽창.e: Literally 'swell and bloat'; both syllables mean getting bigger.
팽창.t: Add 하다 for the verb: 공기가 팽창하다 'the air expands'; for prices, 인플레이션 or 물가 상승 is more common.

치켜세우다.m: to praise highly, to flatter, to praise to the skies; to raise up
치켜세우다.x: People hailed him as the best player.
치켜세우다.e: 치켜 'upward' + 세우다 'to stand up': propping someone up high.

노리다.m: to aim at, target; to watch for (a chance)
노리다.ex: 도둑은 집에 사람이 없는 시간을 노렸어요.
노리다.x: The thief targeted a time when no one was home.
노리다.e: Related to 노려보다, 'to glare at' — keeping your eyes fixed on a target.
노리다.t: Common collocations: 기회를 노리다 (wait for a chance) and 우승을 노리다 (aim to win).

시장 경제.ex: 한국은 시장 경제를 바탕으로 빠르게 성장했습니다.
시장 경제.x: Korea grew rapidly on the basis of a market economy.
시장 경제.e: 경제 comes from 경세제민, 'govern the world, aid the people'.

자만심.ex: 자만심 때문에 준비를 소홀히 했다가 시험을 망쳤어요.
자만심.x: I got overconfident, neglected to prepare, and bombed the test.
자만심.t: 자신감 is healthy confidence; 자만심 is overconfidence that leads you to slack off.

붐.ex: 한때 캠핑 붐이 일면서 장비 판매가 크게 늘었어요.
붐.x: When the camping boom took off, gear sales rose sharply.

셰어하우스.x: I moved into a share house to save on rent.
셰어하우스.e: From English 'share' + 'house'; in English it's usually a 'shared house'.
셰어하우스.t: You have your own or a shared bedroom, but the kitchen, bathroom and living room are shared; popular with students and young workers.

판결문.m: written judgment, text of a ruling
판결문.x: The judge began reading the judgment in the courtroom.
판결문.e: Literally 'decision text': 판결 'ruling' plus 문 'written text'.

자연인.x: Legally, persons are divided into natural persons and corporations.
자연인.e: Literally 'natural person'; on Korean TV it also means a recluse living in the mountains.

후견인.x: The court appointed the grandmother as the child's guardian.
후견인.e: Literally 'a person who watches from behind' and looks after someone.
후견인.t: Also figurative: a powerful backer or patron in politics or business.

일사부재리.m: double jeopardy rule (no retrial for the same case)
일사부재리.ex: 일사부재리 원칙 때문에 같은 사건으로 다시 재판받지 않습니다.
일사부재리.x: Because of the double jeopardy rule, no one is tried twice for the same case.
일사부재리.e: Literally 'one matter is not handled again' — no retrial after a final verdict.

방위산업.ex: 최근 한국의 방위산업 수출이 크게 늘었습니다.
방위산업.x: Korea's defense industry exports have risen sharply recently.
방위산업.t: News headlines usually use the short form: 방산 수출, 방산 기업.

필사본.ex: 이 소설의 필사본이 한 박물관에서 발견되었습니다.
필사본.x: A handwritten copy of this novel was discovered in a museum.
필사본.e: Literally 'brush-copied edition' — copied out by hand.
필사본.t: Pronounced [필싸본]; -본 means 'edition, copy,' as in 목판본, 활자본, 번역본.

회고전.ex: 국립현대미술관에서 그 화가의 회고전이 열리고 있어요.
회고전.x: A retrospective of that painter is being held at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art.

면종복배.m: outward obedience with inner defiance, two-faced compliance
면종복배.ex: 그는 상사 앞에서만 순종하는 면종복배의 태도를 보였어요.
면종복배.x: He showed a two-faced attitude, obedient only in front of his boss.
면종복배.e: Literally 'the face obeys, the belly turns away' — agreeing outwardly, opposing inside.

엘니뇨.ex: 엘니뇨가 발생하면 세계 곳곳에 이상기온이 나타납니다.
엘니뇨.x: When El Niño occurs, abnormal temperatures appear all over the world.
엘니뇨.e: From Spanish 'El Niño' ('the boy', referring to the Christ child).

되뇌다.m: to repeat over and over, to keep saying (to oneself)
되뇌다.ex: 그는 그 말을 속으로 몇 번이나 되뇌었어요.
되뇌다.x: He repeated those words to himself over and over.
되뇌다.e: 되- (again) + 뇌다 (to say again): saying the same words again and again.
되뇌다.t: Spelled 되뇌다, not 되뇌이다 — the -이- version is a very common mistake.

공든 탑이 무너지랴.forms: 공든 탑이 무너지랴 · 공든 탑이 무너지겠어요?
공든 탑이 무너지랴.m: sincere hard work never goes to waste (lit. would a tower built with great care collapse?)
공든 탑이 무너지랴.ex: 공든 탑이 무너지랴, 그동안 열심히 준비했으니까 좋은 결과가 있을 거예요.
공든 탑이 무너지랴.x: Hard work never goes to waste; you've prepared so hard, so you'll get a good result.
공든 탑이 무너지랴.e: 공든 is 공(功) 'effort' + 든 'that has gone into' (from 들다): a tower built with real care won't fall down. -랴 is an old rhetorical question ending.
공든 탑이 무너지랴.t: Used to reassure someone waiting for results. In news, 공든 탑이 무너지다 is used for years of effort being ruined in an instant.
nb: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다
낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 쥐가 듣는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다
